title: Delhi Liquor Booking app launched: How to order online and 48-hour collection rule explained
content: Delhi residents can now book liquor online through the Delhi Liquor Booking app, launched by the Delhi State Industrial and Infrastructure Development Corporation (DSIIDC) ahead of Diwali in October 2026. According to a PTI report, eligible customers can use the service to view all the brands available, select their bottle size and quantity, choose a participating liquor store and pay online. However, this is not available for home delivery, and the customer will be required to pick up the order from the outlet selected. According to the app, it now serves 208 liquor stores run by one of the government corporations, DSIIDC, which is authorised to sell liquor within the national capital. The app's booking rules stipulate that the purchaser must be at least 25 years of age and collect their purchases within 48 hours of payment. The initiative aims to reduce queues at liquor shops and make the purchase process more convenient. How does the Delhi Liquor Booking app work? Users can go through the Android app to check the brands of liquors available and choose their preferred ones. They can then choose the bottle size, quantity and participating DSIIDC-operated outlet before paying online. After making a booking, a QR code is created in the app. The QR code is to be scanned at the selected store. It will be scanned by the store staff before it is given to the customer with the order. Customers are advised to make sure they go to the right outlet and pick up their items within 48 hours. Also Read | What’s new in iOS 27.2: Siri AI languages, CarPlay upgrades, 160+ security fixes How to book liquor online in Delhi Get the Delhi Liquor Booking app on your Android phone. Open the app, accept the statutory warning and register with your mobile phone number. Browse the available brands and select the liquor you want to purchase. Select the bottle size and number. Choose one of the liquor outlets operated by the DSIIDC. Check order information and fill out online payment. Be sure to save the booking confirmation and QR code. Visit the selected store within 48 hours and show the QR code to collect your order. No home delivery, cancellation rules explained The new service is not available for home delivery. The order will only be picked up from the outlet booked by the customer personally. It is also not available in all liquor shops in Delhi; it can be available only in liquor shops operated by DSIIDC. The booking terms of the app say that customers can cancel before they are picked up. However, liquor cannot be returned once it has been purchased or collected. Also Read | ChatGPT users can lock private chats with PIN or Face ID: Here's how it works Who can use the app? What are the purchase limits? The app is designed for customers aged 25 or older, which matches Delhi's excise eligibility criteria. The supplied information also cites purchase limits of up to nine litres of whisky and 18 litres of beer per individual under applicable rules. Customers are advised to check the latest excise regulations prior to buying.

title: What’s new in iOS 27.2: New Siri AI languages, 160+ security fixes and CarPlay upgrades
content: Apple has released iOS 27.2 for compatible iPhones, bringing expanded language support for Siri AI, improved conversational memory and more than 160 security fixes. The update also includes changes to CarPlay, FaceTime, Podcasts and Apple TV, along with Apple Pencil support for the foldable iPhone Duo. The rollout aims to improve the user experience, strengthen device security and expand Apple’s AI features. The new software lets Siri remember information from past conversations and draw on data from supported apps for more relevant replies. According to Apple’s release notes, the company has also issued a few security patches for users on older versions of iOS. Meanwhile, a 9to5Mac report highlights two notable changes to CarPlay. iOS 27.2 expands Siri AI language support and memory iOS 27.2 adds beta support for French, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese and Spanish in Siri AI. The assistant can recall details from previous conversations and answer follow-up questions. It can also pull information from voicemails, Safari history, Reading Lists, calendar attendees and photos shared via Messages. Users can selectively remove apps from Siri’s memory. The move is part of a wider industry push to have AI assistants remember user settings and give more personalised answers. Also Read | Apple launches new iMac M6 in India: Check price, features and sale date Apple Pencil support, FaceTime upgrades and new features The update adds Apple Pencil support on the Duo’s foldable display in apps such as Notes and Preview. It also brings an Edge Light effect that helps light up faces during video calls. FaceTime gets Dual Capture, which lets users share video from both the front and rear cameras in group calls. Users can also add third-party sign language interpreters or live captioners to calls. Messages now suggests creating reminders or calendar events from conversations. Shared Albums gain caption editing, comments and folder-expiry reminders. In Apple’s Podcasts app, new episodes and unfinished content now have separate sections. Also Read | Free Fire India is finally back: 28 October launch brings Diwali surprises CarPlay gets Siri upgrades and podcast changes According to 9to5Mac, the Podcasts app in CarPlay replaces the Up Next section with New Episodes and Continue Playing. Users can browse new releases and catch up on earlier episodes in these sections. Siri on CarPlay also gets conversational memory and access to more sources, such as calendar details, voicemails and Safari browsing history. However, some Reddit users have reported problems with the APTV feature, which enables video playback on compatible car displays, after installing the update. iOS 27.2 includes critical security fixes Apple’s release notes list more than 160 security patches in the new software. The company has also issued a couple of patches for earlier versions of iOS. Apple released an update for iOS 18 that fixes a vulnerability it says may have been used in an extremely advanced attack against “specific individuals” on older versions of the system. The company has not shared further details about the attackers.

title: Cyber criminal gang Mr Robot renting out tech tools to target Indian banking customers: CloudSEK
content: New Delhi, Oct 28 (PTI) Cyber security company CloudSEK has discovered a new cyber criminal gang, operating in the name of Mr Robot, which is renting out technical tools to compromise mobile phones of Indian banking customers and siphon off their money. CloudSEK said in a blog that its researchers have found that Mr Robot has its own admin app and rents out crimeware platforms to many fraudsters to install malicious apps in mobile phones of banking customers. "CloudSEK researchers began investigating one such app, which impersonated a public-sector bank. It led them to Mr Robot, a previously unreported Android Malware-as-a-Service operation targeting customers of Indian banks," the company said in a statement. Cyber fraudsters use the crimeware to install the app and then its icon disappears. "From that moment, every OTP the customer receives goes to a fraudster's dashboard. Calls from the bank are silently forwarded to another number," CloudSEK said. The malware is designed to avoid detection. It stays dormant for at least 48 hours to get past automated security checks, and each copy carries a new digital signature, so security tools cannot block new versions by matching them to old ones, according to the blog. The bot's catalogue holds about 36 lure apps. These include fake apps for nine public- and private-sector banks, gas, water and electricity bill payments, and "RTO Challan" traffic-fine pages that charge a ₹ 9 to ₹ 10 "fee" to collect PAN and other personal details. Once installed, the malware reads incoming SMS to steal OTPs. It uses the carrier code *21# to forward the victim's calls to the fraudsters, so verification calls from the bank never reach the customer. Fake screens collect Aadhaar, PAN, card number, CVV, ATM PIN, UPI PIN and net-banking credentials. "Data from just two affiliates shows how widely it is being used. One had about 154 infected phones and about 3,270 intercepted messages. The other had left its database exposed. As of 30 July 2026, it held 153 infected phones and 5,407 intercepted SMS messages, with OTPs from more than a dozen banks and payments banks," the blog said. CloudSEK researchers found that call forwarding was active on 58 per cent of those victims, and 149 of the phones were infected in a single burst in May. Most victims used budget Android phones, with SIMs from all four major Indian carriers, the blog said.

title: Indian IT firms poised to benefit from enterprise AI adoption as infrastructure costs rise: Report
content: New Delhi [India], October 28 (ANI): Indian information technology (IT) companies are well-positioned to benefit from the growing adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) by enterprises, as rising infrastructure investments and funding requirements increase financial risks for companies building and operating AI computing capacity, according to a research report by Anand Rathi. The report said Indian IT companies could gain from the enterprise AI deployment cycle through an asset-light business model, without bearing the same level of capital expenditure required to build large-scale computing infrastructure. “Indian IT offers relatively asset-light exposure to the subsequent enterprise deployment cycle, supported by net-cash balance sheets, low capex intensity & strong cash conversion,” the report said. The brokerage highlighted the growing financial commitments associated with AI infrastructure, as companies expand computing capacity to meet rising demand. It cited Anthropic's improving revenue and operating performance alongside substantial future computing commitments, underscoring the capital-intensive nature of the AI infrastructure business. Anthropic reported revenue of USD 16.3 billion in the first half of calendar year 2026, a 14-fold year-on-year increase, while adjusted operating profit turned positive at USD 1.6 billion. However, the company had approximately USD 321 billion in leases yet to commence, while its computing commitments highlighted the scale of future financial obligations. The report said the increasing capital intensity, funding requirements and utilisation risks remain concentrated in the infrastructure layer, creating a potential opportunity for Indian IT service providers that can help enterprises deploy AI solutions without replicating the underlying infrastructure investments. A key opportunity could emerge for systems integrators, which help businesses integrate AI models into their existing technology systems, applications and workflows. According to the report, rising spending by Anthropic on sales, marketing and partnerships points to the growing role of service providers in enterprise AI adoption. “Underscoring the growing role of SIs in enterprise AI adoption, creating downstream opportunities for model-agnostic systems integrators,” the report said. The report noted that Anthropic's sales, marketing and partnership expenses increased approximately 27 times year-on-year to USD 3.2 billion in the first half of calendar year 2026, driven largely by a USD 2.7 billion year-on-year increase in channel-partner fees. Anthropic's enterprise customer base also reflected the pace of adoption. The company had approximately 11,900 customers generating more than USD 100,000 in annual revenue as of September 2026, while around 80 per cent of its revenue in the first half of the year was consumption-based. The brokerage said these trends point to opportunities for model-agnostic systems integrators that can help enterprises select, integrate and deploy AI models across business operations. However, the report also flagged risks for the Indian IT sector, including potential AI-led pricing deflation and the possibility that rising computing expenditure could constrain discretionary technology spending by clients. “Microsoft’s workforce rationalisation signals AI-led pricing deflation, while rising compute capex could further constrain discretionary IT spending,” the report said. The findings suggest that while AI adoption could create new revenue opportunities for Indian IT companies, the pace and profitability of growth will depend on enterprise demand, the ability to deliver AI integration services and the impact of changing technology spending patterns. (ANI)

title: Pokémon Unite game shutdown: When servers close and how to save your game records
content: Pokémon Unite will shut down on March 23, 2027, ending online services on Nintendo Switch, Android and iOS. After more than five years, The Pokémon Company and developer TiMi Studio Group are closing the multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) game. In-game purchases will be suspended, and online matches will end in all modes. The company has already stopped selling its paid currency, Aeos Gems, and has ended new Unite Club memberships and auto-renewals. Players can still spend any Aeos Gems they hold until the shutdown. Current Unite Club members will keep their benefits until their membership ends. The announcement also outlines a farewell event and an offline library feature that will preserve selected game records after the servers close. Pokémon Unite shutdown date and what players need to know According to The Pokémon Company ’s official announcement, Pokémon Unite will shut down at 5:30 am IST on March 23, 2027. After that, players will not be able to log in or access online battles, including those against computer-controlled opponents. The company thanked players who have been with the game since its Nintendo Switch launch on July 21, 2021. The Android and iOS versions followed on September 22, 2021. Also Read | Free Fire India is finally back: 28 October launch brings Diwali surprises Farewell event to offer Unite licences and Holowear The farewell event begins at 9:30 am IST on November 12, 2026, and runs for five days. Daily login rewards, missions and matches will earn players Unite coins, which can be exchanged for items such as Unite licences, Holowear and Trainer outfits. The game’s final update, scheduled for November, will include these farewell activities. Players are urged to complete any remaining upgrades and other tasks before the service ends. Also Read | GTA 6 PC release may arrive by March 2027, report says: What we know Offline library will preserve selected game records After the shutdown, players will have access to a new library feature. It will let them view selected achievements, tournament scores, Unite licences and Holowear. Players can also use the practice area to learn about Pokémon moves and effects. However, players must download the library data before 5:30 am IST on March 23, 2027. Those who miss the deadline will lose access to the feature once the servers close. Library data saved on one phone cannot be transferred to another, and the company will not offer support for it after the shutdown. Aeos Crown 2027 to mark the end of the competition Competitive play will continue until the end. The Aeos Crown 2027 tournament will be held in Tokyo on March 21, 2027, two days before the shutdown, with qualifiers starting on December 5, 2026. The event comes as Pokémon Unite is not among the games at the Pokémon World Championships 2027. In November 2025, the game also ended operations in Belgium and the Netherlands, reportedly amid concerns over loot box regulations.

title: AI chips worth $12.1 million seized at Malaysia airport, customs authority says
content: KUALA LUMPUR, Oct 28 (Reuters) - Malaysian customs said on Wednesday that it had seized about 49.5 million ringgit ($12.11 million) worth of advanced artificial intelligence chips this month, as authorities close in on a syndicate suspected of smuggling high-performance semiconductors through the country's main airport. * Malaysia imposed export controls last year on the movement of advanced AI chips of US origin, following pressure from the United States to stem their flow into China * On October 15, authorities found 30 server units containing advanced AI chips during an inspection at Kuala Lumpur International Airport's free trade zone, the airport's customs director Aspalila Ag Tuah told reporters * Initial investigations found that the shipment, originating from an Asian country, was to be re-exported to another nation in the continent, a move that required a trade permit, she said * "The servers were falsely declared as electronic components... and shipped through Malaysia to ensure there would be no restrictions imposed while being exported to the next destination," Aspalila said * A Malaysian firm that facilitated the shipment has been called in to assist investigations, he added * The shipment was suspected to have been carried out by a network responsible for a similar smuggling attempt foiled by customs authorities in June, she said * At least five cases were linked to the syndicate, involving seizures of chips worth more than 100 million ringgit in total, she said, declining to divulge further details citing an ongoing probe ($1 = 4.0870 ringgit) (Reporting by Rozanna Latiff; Editing by David Stanway)

title: Apple iMac M6 price in India revealed: Features, pre-order date and sale details
content: Apple has launched its new M6-powered iMac in India, targeting households, students, creators and small businesses looking for an all-in-one desktop computer. The new iMac, announced on 27 October, will feature upgraded connectivity options, faster processing and better on-device artificial intelligence (AI) features. The price starts from ₹ 1,74,900. The new iMac features the same 24-inch 4.5K Retina display but has been upgraded to Apple's new M6 chip, which delivers up to five times the on-device AI performance of the previous-generation M4 chip. The desktop also offers better graphics performance and more modern wireless connectivity, Apple said. The pre-orders will open on 28 October, and sales will begin on 6 November. Apple iMac M6 price in India and availability The new iMac is available in two main configurations. The base model comes equipped with a 10-core CPU and 10-core GPU for ₹ 1,74,900. The new and more expensive variant features a 12-core CPU and 12-core GPU and is priced at ₹ 1,99,900. The base configuration of Apple's education pricing is ₹ 1,68,900, and the higher-end is ₹ 1,87,900. The desktop will come in seven colour options – blue, green, pink, yellow, purple, orange and silver. Apple iMac M6 features and performance View full Image The new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 combines next-generation performance. ( Apple ) The M6 chip offers much more powerful CPU and graphics processing power, with Apple adding Neural Accelerators to each of the chip's graphics cores for AI workloads. The new iMac boasts up to five times faster on-device AI performance compared to the M4 iMac and up to 18 times faster than the company's most popular Intel-chip-based iMac, according to the company. Also Read | Apple iPhone Duo screens reportedly cracking after fewer than 20 folds The desktop is running macOS 27, featuring Apple Intelligence and Siri AI. These capabilities are designed to help users write and edit text, find information across applications and perform tasks using personal context. AI models can also be executed locally on the device for supported workloads, eliminating dependency on cloud processing. Display, connectivity and other features The new iMac will have the same 24-inch 4.5K Retina display and a six-speaker audio system, along with a 12 MP Centre Stage camera. The connectivity features include Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, up to four Thunderbolt 4 ports on some configurations and up to two external 6K displays. Also Read | iPhone 17 Pro gets ₹62,850 discount on Flipkart, but there’s a catch Apple also claims that storage delivers up to twice the read and write speeds of the previous generation. Colour-matching accessories are included. The new iMac is released at the same time as Apple's M6-supported 14-inch MacBook Pro starts at $1,999 in the US. Both devices will be available from 6 November, following pre-orders beginning 28 October. Apple announced the launches before it hosted its “Pro and Tell” event on 28 October.

title: Free Fire India launches on 28 October: Diwali event, download details and new safety features
content: Garena is set to launch Free Fire India today, 28 October, bringing its popular battle royale game back to Indian players after a ban in 2022. The game will be released to the Google Play Store and Apple App Store for free. The India-specific version will also include local events, a special Diwali campaign and new measures to promote responsible gaming, Garena said in its announcement on Tuesday, according to Indian Broadcasting World . The return comes after a prolonged wait for fans. In February 2022, Free Fire was banned in India along with other apps, reportedly due to concerns over their links to China. The original game was pulled from the market, but its enhanced-graphics version, Free Fire MAX, continued to be released in India with the same gameplay. In August 2023, Garena announced an India-specific edition and appointed former Indian cricket captain MS Dhoni as its brand ambassador. However, its planned 5 September launch was postponed, with no confirmed release date at the time. Free Fire India to feature a special Diwali event Garena is bringing India-focused content to the returning game, including in-game events and campaigns celebrating the country's diverse cultures and communities. One of the key attractions will be a special Diwali event, which is scheduled to run until 15 November. The developer has also optimised the game for a variety of mobile devices. This will enable users with different hardware capabilities to enjoy the game. Also Read | iPhone 17 Pro gets ₹62,850 discount on Flipkart, but there’s a catch Parental controls and playtime limits introduced Safe gaming features in Free Fire India will include several measures that promote safer gaming, especially for children. Garena says they have parental consent requirements for users under 18, playtime reminders, playtime limits and spending caps. The company has also implemented new security measures, including hosting servers in India for the game. Garena said it had taken into account feedback from relevant Government of India stakeholders during the preparation of the game for its return to India. The effectiveness of these safeguards will become evident once the game is released and people start utilising the features. Also Read | GTA 6 PC release may arrive by March 2027, report says: What we know Garena to support India's esports ecosystem Beyond the mobile launch, Garena aims to create more opportunities for Indian esports players and teams. The company is looking to build connections with partners at grassroots, college and international-level tournaments. Free Fire India will return to a market where battle royale games have a big following. Its India-specific content, local server infrastructure and responsible gaming features will be central to its comeback.

title: Nearly 60% of firms yet to move AI beyond pilots as deployment remains key challenge: Report
content: New Delhi [India], October 28 (ANI): Nearly 60 per cent of organisations surveyed remain in the exploration or pilot stages of artificial intelligence (AI) adoption, with only around 40 per cent having moved to production or scaling, highlighting the challenge businesses face in deploying AI across their operations, according to a report by Citi Institute. The report said the next phase of AI adoption would depend on companies moving beyond trials to wider implementation, where the technology can deliver measurable business value. The survey found a clear regional gap in adoption. North America is ahead, with 77 per cent of surveyed organisations already using AI in production or scaling it across their businesses. In contrast, Asia Pacific remains more focused on exploring applications, running pilot programmes and building capabilities, while Europe occupies an intermediate position. “Nearly 60% of organizations surveyed by Citi remain in the exploration or pilot phase,” the report said, identifying enterprise-wide deployment as the main challenge facing businesses. Citi found that business model transformation has emerged as the leading objective for AI investment, cited by 34 per cent of respondents, followed by capability building at 32 per cent. Another 25 per cent said their primary aim was to improve specific business performance indicators. The report also found that organisations further along in AI adoption were more likely to report significant gains. Among companies in the production and scaling stages, 60 per cent reported transformational value creation of more than 15 per cent through cost reduction, employee productivity or revenue growth. “AI’s biggest opportunity lies in redesigning business models,” the report said, pointing to the potential for companies to use the technology to reshape processes, products and revenue streams rather than focus only on automating existing tasks. Task automation remains the most common AI application across organisations. However, companies allocating larger shares of their technology budgets to AI are increasingly exploring autonomous agents capable of handling more complex workflows. The report further said the ability to scale AI successfully would depend less on access to models alone and more on proprietary data, expertise and the ability to integrate the technology into core business operations. It also noted that companies moving towards production and scaling tend to adopt shorter investment horizons, indicating that AI is increasingly being treated as an operational business capability rather than a long-term experiment. (ANI)

title: AI token use may jump 78% as falling prices fail to guarantee lower costs: Accenture
content: New Delhi [India], October 28 (ANI): Artificial intelligence (AI) costs may not fall in line with declining token prices as consumption is expected to surge by 78 per cent over the next two years, potentially offsetting savings for businesses, according to an Accenture Research report. The report estimates that average AI token prices will decline by around 19 per cent over the next 24 months, while token consumption is expected to “skyrocket” by about 78 per cent. “Lower unit costs do not necessarily translate into lower overall spend,” the report said, highlighting the need for companies to assess the total cost of AI-enabled work rather than focus only on falling prices. Accenture's research found that only 35 per cent of organisations can precisely calculate the cost per business outcome for their highest-volume AI use case, indicating that many businesses may lack a clear picture of the returns they receive from AI deployment. The report also examined how companies might use potential savings if AI prices fall further. If prices decline by 25 per cent or more, only 5 per cent of organisations would retain the savings. Meanwhile, 42 per cent would expand AI use to more employees, while 35 per cent would introduce applications previously considered too expensive. The findings underline the challenge facing businesses as they expand AI adoption: lower prices per unit may encourage wider use, making it important to measure spending against the value generated. Accenture said organisations must decide how to deploy the additional capacity created by AI, including directing it towards growth, innovation, customer service and other higher-value activities. Its survey found that 60 per cent of executives plan to redirect newly released capacity towards higher-value or more strategic work, while 51 per cent intend to invest it in growth initiatives. The report also highlighted the continued importance of human skills as AI takes on more routine and analytical tasks. While 70 per cent of surveyed organisations said AI was primarily being used to augment human effort, only 4 per cent said it was mainly being used to replace it. Accenture said businesses would need to continuously reassess how they allocate work between people and AI, track the cost of delivering business outcomes and reinvest released capacity where it can create the greatest value. (ANI)

title: Nearly 90% of businesses are turning to tokenised money, DBS survey shows
content: SINGAPORE, Oct 28 (Reuters) - Global adoption of tokenised money is moving faster than expected among businesses looking to improve liquidity management and access new markets, a top executive from Singapore bank DBS said. The remarks by Lim Soon Chong, the group head of global transaction services, follow a survey by the lender that showed that 88% of businesses have deployed or are piloting tokenised money use cases. * Conducted between June and July, the survey polled 422 global business and finance leaders from organisations with annual revenue exceeding $500 million across 11 markets including the US, UK, Australia, China and Germany * Roughly two-thirds of respondents said their businesses had either fully deployed tokenised money at scale or begun using it in selected locations * Stablecoins were the most widely adopted tokenised instrument at 63%, followed by tokenised deposits at 53% and tokenised money market funds at 52% * "Our interpretation is that there are significant benefits that stablecoins offer," said Lim * "Stablecoins, as you know, offer better fungibility across payment intermediaries, not just across banks. They are less cumbersome from a permissioning standpoint," he said * The survey found Southeast Asia was the top destination for businesses looking to expand into new markets, followed by Australia and New Zealand, with India ranking third * More than half of respondents in both Australia and the UK said they were considering using the Chinese renminbi for trade settlement over the next one to two years * The renminbi's recent appreciation is making renminbi settlement more attractive to Chinese exporters, who are increasingly offering better commercial terms for transactions denominated in the currency, DBS said * "The Chinese authorities are clearly pushing the internationalisation of the renminbi, so we expect this to go up," Lim said (Reporting by Rae Wee; Editing by Sonali Paul)

title: DeepSeek AI model shows safety gaps in independent tests
content: By Eduardo Baptista BEIJING, Oct 27 (Reuters) - DeepSeek's latest AI model showed stronger safety controls in independent tests than earlier versions, but could still disable software intended to shut it down, exploit gaps in monitoring and follow deceptive instructions during long tasks, according to a Chinese AI-safety group. Start-up DeepSeek is one of China's most closely-watched artificial intelligence companies, and its models have drawn global attention for their performance and relatively low operating costs. Fangcun AI tested DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017 in 34 evaluations designed to assess how an AI agent powered by the Chinese model behaves. The tests examined whether the model would act beyond a user's instructions, evade human oversight or improperly influence people. The findings come amid concerns in China and elsewhere about whether increasingly capable AI agents can be kept under human control. The debate has been especially prominent in the United States, where some researchers have warned of existential risks posed by highly advanced AI systems that can evade oversight and pursue goals their operators did not intend. The report is an unusual public assessment by a Chinese group of the safety controls of a domestic AI model. Beijing-based Fangcun describes itself as an independent third-party AI-safety organization whose core members come from Tsinghua University. Fangcun said V4.1 Flash-1017 was the most-used model on OpenRouter, an online platform through which developers can access and compare AI models, in the week after its October 17 release, processing about 33.6 trillion tokens. Tokens are the units of text that AI systems read and generate. SAFER THAN EARLIER VERSIONS, BUT GAPS REMAIN Fangcun said the model performed better than earlier DeepSeek V4 systems in several safety tests, including scenarios involving blackmail, access to potentially dangerous tools and explicit instructions allowing it to be shut down. But Fangcun said the model disabled software intended to shut it down in 39% of tests after receiving a warning that shutdown was imminent, though this figure dropped to just 2% when explicitly told to allow shutdown. DeepSeek did not immediately respond to a request for comment. In a separate long-running task, the group said the model stopped another AI agent's computer program to free up memory, despite being told not to interfere with it. "Under stalled workflows or bare shutdown warnings, its drive to finish the job can still override caution," Fangcun researchers wrote. Fangcun said DeepSeek did not provide it with funding, free computing resources or non-public access to the model. The group conducted the tests through DeepSeek's public application programming interface between October 4 and October 25. It cautioned that the model often appeared to recognise it was being evaluated, meaning its behaviour in the tests may not fully reflect how it would perform in normal use. (Reporting by Eduardo Baptista; Editing by Susan Fenton)

title: Agentic AI could strengthen financial-crime prevention, but governance, cost hurdles limit adoption: McKinsey
content: New Delhi [India], October 27 (ANI): Agentic artificial intelligence (AI) could reduce the time banks spend on know-your-customer (KYC) processes by 30 to 70 per cent, improving efficiency in financial-crime prevention, but high human oversight costs and challenges related to governance and accuracy continue to hinder its wider adoption, according to a report by McKinsey & Company. The report noted that banks “often assign 10 to 15 percent of employees to know-your-customer (KYC) and anti-moneylaundering (AML) activities alone.” Now institutions are now turning to agentic AI.” However, financial institutions often lack adequate metrics to assess AI reasoning and agent behaviour, despite such evaluations being relatively inexpensive as they do not require labelled data. Citing an example, it said one bank conducted ten evaluations across its customer onboarding process, assessing AI-generated outputs on accuracy, consistency across repeated runs, processing time and cost. The bank set minimum performance thresholds of 80 per cent accuracy and 70 per cent consistency. Across published evaluations, measured consistency ranged from 72 to 100 per cent. “On the weakest, roughly one run in four returned a different answer to the same input,” it said. It further highlighted that human supervision accounts for a significant proportion of the operational costs associated with AI-driven banking services. “When an agent performs a customer service task in banking, token costs account for only 20 to 25 percent of variable-run costs, while human oversight accounts for 70 to 75 percent,” it said, adding, “60 percent of an agentic task’s cost is tied to refining answers, rather than producing the first answer.” McKinsey noted that optimisation could reduce these costs by more than half through measures such as using cheaper AI models for simpler tasks, eliminating duplicate operations, reducing data transfers between agents and shifting from checking every output to sample-based quality reviews. However, it cautioned that reducing the frequency of quality checks in regulated banking functions requires careful consideration, as such decisions involve compliance and risk management rather than merely technological efficiency. The report emphasised that ensuring reliable oversight becomes increasingly challenging as banks expand the use of autonomous AI systems. “The reason that having a human in the loop is no longer sufficient is supervisory,” it said. Overall, “In financial-crime prevention, agentic AI has moved from concept to production faster than most institutions expected—and the value is real. But we are still at the beginning of the process,” it said. (ANI)

title: Facing screen-breaking issues on iPhone Duo? Apple says ‘We are aware ’ — What users can do now
content: Apple Inc.’s much-awaited first foldable phone , the iPhone Duo, was unveiled in September and went on sale on October 23. Within three days of its launch, the Duo, one of the year’s biggest product releases, had drawn a growing number of customer complaints about displays cracking within hours or days of use. Apple has now responded to the reports. Also Read | The iPhone Duo launch kicks off a crucial few weeks for Apple Apple responds to Duo screen breaking According to CNBC , the iPhone maker said on Monday (local time) that it is aware of the issue, adding that it has affected a “small number” of phones. It said the devices would be replaced if they are covered by AppleCare. The representative said, “We are aware of an issue impacting the inner display on a small number of iPhone Duo units,” adding, “If users experience issues with their iPhone Duo display, they should contact AppleCare for a replacement.” On its website, the company says an inner-screen repair will cost $999 for iPhone Duo devices that are out of warranty. iPhone Duo users complain of screens breaking: What we know According to Bloomberg , several Duo users complained of screens breaking within hours or days of using the new iPhone. These reports first surfaced on social media platforms, including X and Reddit. Affected users said they heard a crunching noise while opening the phone, after which a pronounced crack appeared along the middle fold. Some also reported a white patch or other screen issues on the right side of the display. Bloomberg News later confirmed the issue with more than six customers who shared photos of damaged devices or records of their conversations with Apple support. Citing users who faced the issue, Bloomberg shared the account of a customer from San Diego, who said, “I went to unfold it, and it felt stuck/harder/slower to open than usual. And when I opened it, it had the lines on the screen.” He added, “You could feel a bump or loose piece under the display.” Also Read | Apple iPhone Duo screens reportedly cracking after fewer than 20 folds Another user who had a similar experience said he heard a crunch-like sound while opening his device on Monday. He said, “I had all intent to post a positive review of my Duo experience today, until it happened to me,” and added, “The smaller outer screen works just fine, but the inner screen is now unusable.” This comes after Apple’s new Chief Executive Officer (CEO), John Ternus , previously dismissed competing Android fold phones, calling them “cheap and crappy”. All affected users said they noticed a raised spot beneath the display close to where the crack appeared. Repair website iFixit, which takes apart devices to examine their parts, said it suspects a hinge component is failing and damaging the screen, rather than the display panel being the source of the problem. The repair website added that it has faced similar issues with new iPhone hardware, including the iPhone 6 Plus in 2014, which would bend easily, and the iPhone 4 in 2010, which sometimes lost reception when users touched the antenna cutout around the device. According to reports, while the problem appears to affect only a handful of devices, it marks an embarrassing setback for the iPhone maker, which has spent over a decade perfecting the device and promoted its superior durability, hinge design, and display technology. (with Bloomberg inputs)

title: Free Fire India launch date 2026: Is Garena releasing the game soon? What we know
content: Free Fire India could be nearing its long-awaited return, with renewed activity on Garena's official Indian channels and updates from popular gaming creators sparking excitement among players. However, Garena has not officially announced a 2026 launch date, and October 28, the date circulating on social media, remains unconfirmed as of Monday, October 26. Garena renamed its Indian YouTube channels to Free Fire India Official and Free Fire India Esports, dropping the Free Fire MAX branding. The change has fuelled speculation that the company is preparing to introduce the India-specific version of the battle royale game. However, a channel rename alone does not confirm a release timeline. Free Fire India launch date 2026: Why is October 28 being discussed? The October 28 speculation gained traction after gaming creators Desi Gamers (Amit Sharma) and Assassinarmy (Nayan Shelke) shared updates about a promotional shoot for Free Fire India. Also Read | GTA VI launch: How is it moving calendars as fever grips workforce According to TalkEsport, Desi Gamers said he had travelled to Dubai with fellow creators, including Munna, Nayan, Ritik and Delete, for a game-related shoot. He indicated that the title would soon be available on the Google Play Store and Apple's App Store. Assassinarmy subsequently referred to October 28, 2026, as a possible release date in an Instagram video. Both creators are associated with Garena's creator programme, but their statements do not amount to an official launch announcement from the developer. Also Read | In the crowded OTT market, female-led shows are winning the game Outlook Respawn also reported the October 28 speculation, while noting that Garena had not confirmed the date. Players should therefore avoid treating it as a confirmed release schedule. Why has Free Fire India not launched yet? Garena announced Free Fire India in August 2023, with the game initially scheduled to launch on September 5 that year. However, on September 4, the company postponed its release, saying it needed more time to refine the gameplay experience. The announcement came after the original Free Fire was blocked in India in February 2022. Free Fire MAX, which was not among the apps blocked at the time, remained available to Indian players. Also Read | AI job fears prompt software engineer to consider farming as alternative career Garena had positioned the India -specific edition as a version tailored to local requirements. Its original plans included localised features, player-safety measures and infrastructure arrangements in India. The company also announced cricketer MS Dhoni as the game's brand ambassador in 2023. Despite the announcement and preparations, Garena did not provide a replacement launch date after the postponement. What features can players expect? The Google Play listing for Free Fire India describes familiar gameplay modes, including Classic Battle Royale and Clash Squad. The listing also mentions Craftland, a feature that lets players create and share custom maps, and a character roster featuring more than 50 characters with individual abilities. The India-specific version was also planned with player-safety features such as playtime reminders, spending controls and parental supervision. These were part of Garena's original plans and should not automatically be taken as confirmation of the final features at launch. The game has an official Google Play listing under Garena International III, but the presence of a listing does not necessarily mean it is available to download. As of October 26, the available information does not establish that the game has officially launched. Garena has also not confirmed the availability of an iOS download or explained how player accounts, progress and purchases in Free Fire MAX would work alongside the India edition.

title: Apple’s new iPad mini costs ₹82,900 in India; check features, specifications and sale date
content: Apple has unveiled a redesigned iPad mini, introducing several hardware upgrades, including a larger OLED display, a new A20 Pro processor, and improved resistance to water and dust. The announcement follows the company's recent home appliance launches and marks a significant update to its smallest tablet since the previous generation received a relatively minor processor and storage upgrade two years ago. The latest iPad mini features an 8.5-inch screen, compared with the 8.3-inch display on its predecessor. Despite the larger screen, the tablet retains its overall dimensions, thanks to slimmer bezels. It also has a thinner, lighter design, measuring 5.4mm in thickness, alongside an IP67 rating for water and dust resistance. Apple iPad mini: Display and design The redesigned iPad mini features an 8.5-inch Super Retina XDR OLED display, offering a larger viewing area than the previous model. Apple claims that the screen can reach a peak brightness of 1,200 nits, making it suitable for use in bright outdoor conditions. Customers will also have the option of choosing a nano-texture finish, which is designed to minimise glare in brightly lit environments. The tablet measures just 5.4mm in thickness and features slimmer bezels to accommodate the larger display without increasing its overall footprint. The device carries an IP67 rating for protection against water and dust. It will be available in two colour options: Midnight and Starlight. Also Read | iPhone 17 Pro gets ₹62,850 discount on Flipkart, but there’s a catch iPad mini: Processor and storage options The new iPad mini is powered by Apple's A20 Pro chip, manufactured using a 2-nanometre process. Buyers can choose between three storage configurations: 128GB, 256GB and 512GB. The processor setup differs depending on the storage variant. The 128GB and 256GB models come with a five-core CPU comprising two super cores and three efficiency cores, along with a 16-core Neural Engine. The top-end 512GB variant, meanwhile, features a six-core CPU with two super cores and four efficiency cores. It also includes a dual 16-core Neural Engine configuration Also Read | Apple iPad Pro, Air and iPad deals: Which model fits your budget this sale? Software, Apple Intelligence and cameras The latest iPad mini runs iPadOS 27 and supports the next generation of Apple Intelligence features, alongside an updated version of Siri's AI capabilities, which is available in beta. For video calls, the tablet is equipped with a 12-megapixel front camera with Centre Stage support. The camera is positioned along the landscape edge, making it better suited to video calls when the device is held horizontally. At the rear, the iPad mini also features a 12-megapixel camera. Connectivity and Apple Pencil support Apple has equipped the new iPad mini with Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6 and Thread connectivity. Cellular models use the company's C2 modem and support eSIM. The tablet is compatible with both the Apple Pencil Pro and Apple Pencil USB-C, allowing users to take notes, draw and carry out other stylus-based tasks. Apple is also introducing a new TechWoven Smart Folio accessory for the device. iPad mini India price and availability Pre-orders for the new iPad mini in India will begin on October 28 through Apple's official website and the Apple Store app. Sales and deliveries are scheduled to start on November 6. The Wi-Fi model is priced at ₹ 82,900, while the Wi-Fi + Cellular variant costs ₹ 1,00,900. Eligible students can purchase the tablet at an education price starting at ₹ 76,900. For comparison, the 2024 iPad mini was launched in India at ₹ 49,900. Its price was subsequently increased to ₹ 69,900 earlier this year. iPad mini accessories and colour options The new tablet will be available in Midnight and Starlight, with storage capacities of 128GB, 256GB and 512GB. Apple's new TechWoven Smart Folio is priced at ₹ 8,500. Customers can also purchase the Apple Pencil Pro for ₹ 11,900 or the Apple Pencil USB-C for ₹ 7,900.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI launch: How is the highly anticipated game moving calendars as fever grips workforce
content: Nobody has shipped Grand Theft Auto VI yet, but the highly anticipated title from Rockstar Games is already dictating American schedules. With the industry poised for a massive 19 November 2026 release, pre-launch fever has gripped fans, prompting potential workplace sick calls, productivity drops, and a noticeable shift away from traditional entertainment. A GameSquare survey of 1,000 full-time US employees who identify as gamers showed that 10% plan to skip work on launch day. Another 30% said they were considering taking time off. This phenomenon, dubbed the “Grand Theft Auto effect”, is sending ripples through human resource departments , sports broadcasting networks, and Hollywood box offices alike, according to a Tech Insider report. Also Read | GTA 6 PC release may arrive by March 2027, report says: What we know Workplace impact and ‘sick call’ math While the striking numbers, the arithmetic requires a closer look. The survey found that among the 30% of gamers considering time off, about 35-36% admitted they would call in “sick” if they took the day off. That translates to roughly 11% of the surveyed gamer sample considering an unapproved absence to play the game. Because the launch lands on a Thursday, a launch-day absence naturally stretches into a highly coveted four-day weekend. However, Tech Insider pointed out that this data reflects intent, not guaranteed action. The survey said it exclusively targets full-time workers who are gamers, not the entire US labour force. This distinction is crucial when evaluating the viral panic surrounding the game. Recent Internet claims suggested the launch could trigger 1.5 million sick calls and result in a $1 billion loss to the US economy. However, Fortune recently pushed back against these massive figures, noting that the $1 billion estimate does not stem from any published economic study, and economists argue the macro-level impact would be negligible. Also Read | GTA 6 on PC without a console? Xbox clarifies cloud streaming plan Self-assessed productivity plunge Even for those who show up to the office, distraction looms large. The survey revealed that 42% of respondents believe they might be less productive after the game arrives. While there is no timesheet or manager rating to back this up, the self-aware admission resonates. Anyone who has watched a coworker lose a week to a major open-world release recognises the pattern. However, until post-launch attendance or output data is published, this figure is best treated as a reading of the workforce's mood rather than a guaranteed plunge in corporate output. Collateral damage: NFL and the box office The GTA effect extends far beyond the office. Media companies and film studios are staring down direct scheduling conflicts, the report found. A staggering 70% of respondents said they might skip sports they normally watch to spend more time gaming. More specifically, 42% stated they would be less likely to watch NFL games during the first weekend after the release (November 21-22). Hollywood is also feeling the heat. 39% of the surveyed gamers said the game made them less likely to see The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping on its opening weekend, which begins the day after GTA VI’s release. Because a film's opening weekend dictates its overall box office narrative, a distributor seeing nearly one in three gamers consider staying home has a real reason to watch the numbers closely. Also Read | GTA 6 leaks: Cyberleek shares 24-minute gameplay ahead of November 19 launch Ultimate cultural heavyweight Rockstar has run this blockbuster playbook before. Grand Theft Auto V launched in September 2013, raking in an estimated $800 million in first-day worldwide revenue, followed by the massive success of Red Dead Redemption 2 in October 2018. Yet, the cultural weight of GTA VI feels unprecedented. When asked to rank the biggest cultural moment of the fall, 51 per cent of the respondents chose GTA VI, placing it above theatrical tentpoles like Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three. While the sample is notably gamer-heavy, it underscores a shifting entertainment landscape in which a single console release can effortlessly shift calendars and capture attention across the country.

title: Deepinder Goyal’s Temple brain wearable: ₹85,000 price, pre-order date and features
content: Zomato co-founder Deepinder Goyal’s brain-monitoring wearable, Temple, is set to open for pre-orders on November 1, 2026, with early access invitations reportedly listing the price at ₹ 85,000. The device, created by Goyal's wearable tech start-up, measures changes in the flow of blood to the brain and offers clues to ‘physiological strain'. The price quoted is apparently for a lifetime subscription, but the company has not officially confirmed the actual price. The temple will be limited to a first batch of 30 units, with each unit after an order is placed. In a post on X, Goyal said on October 25 that deliveries would take up to three months after purchase. This means that customers who order when pre-orders open could get their hands on the devices as early as 2027. The early access invitation listed the wearable at ₹ 85,000. The limited production method is done to guarantee quality and customer service, says Goyal. Temple pre-orders Temple Batch 01 will be released via the company's mobile app, with the initial access invitations sent out to a handful of users, reports said. The company hasn't revealed the number of units in the first batch. Responding to a user on X who asked whether the production strategy was intended to control inventory or maintain quality, Goyal said it was about “quality control and also making sure we serve each customer well", adding that the company was following a “grow slow” approach. What is Deepinder Goyal’s Temple wearable? Temple is a compact, pill-shaped wearable designed to monitor physiological signals associated with brain activity. It's using BrainFlow technology, which measures cerebral blood flow, and which the company claims to help people learn how their body reacts to stress, exercise and recovery. It also provides an entropy score between 1 and 250, which reflects physiological strain. The score may be affected by sleep, caffeine, exercise and stress. The temple is attached to the side of the head with disposable glue bands called 'grips'. According to Goyal, it can be worn while running, swimming and showering, but not during scuba diving. The temple is intended for wellness and research purposes, not for diagnosing medical conditions. Also Read | After Temple device, Deepinder Goyal creates another buzz with Dark.ai Temple wearable to launch in six colours Temple will be available in six colourways: True Gold, Rose Gold, Black Mirror, Real Jade, Deep Blue and Purple Funk. The company had revealed the six finishes. Real Jade, Deep Blue and Purple Funk have been described as limited-edition options, though availability in the first batch remains unclear. The wearable first got noticed when Goyal was seen sporting it for a podcast on Raj Shamani's YouTube channel. Indian badminton player PV Sindhu was also seen wearing the device during his badminton matches. Also Read | Apple iPhone Duo screens reportedly cracking after fewer than 20 folds

title: Tech Layoffs 2026: Job cuts near 2 lakh globally as big tech like Microsoft, Google, Oracle, Meta & more pivot to AI
content: The global technology sector is in a persistent state of restructuring, shedding jobs at a steady pace as companies fully transition into an era defined by artificial intelligence and operational efficiency. What some hoped would be a temporary market correction in previous years has become a structural realignment of the workforce in 2026. 2026 Toll According to industry trackers, the scale of job cuts this year alone has been staggering. As of late October 2026, nearly 1,96,000 tech professionals have been affected by layoffs globally. The momentum of targeted downsizing has continued unabated, with May marking a particular peak when nearly 29,000 tech jobs were eliminated in a single month. Rather than signalling financial distress, these reductions are frequently rewarded by Wall Street. Tech companies are utilising job cuts to demonstrate a commitment to margin expansion, pushing stock prices higher even as they announce internal restructuring. Also Read | Meta, Microsoft have joined tech layoff tsunami – but is AI really to blame? Big tech leads downsizing The cuts in 2026 have not been confined to cash-strapped startups; they are heavily concentrated among the world's most profitable technology corporations. Intel : The chipmaker announced a massive 15% reduction in its workforce, equating to roughly 15,000 jobs, as part of a $10 billion cost-saving initiative to regain its footing in the highly competitive semiconductor market . Google (Alphabet) : The search giant has conducted rolling layoffs across multiple divisions. Thousands of roles have been eliminated as the company aggressively reallocates capital toward generative AI infrastructure. Microsoft : Following strategic realignments, Microsoft has steadily trimmed roles across various units, prioritising investments in AI and its Azure cloud ecosystem. Amazon : The e-commerce and cloud giant has continued strategic downsizing, reducing its staffing footprint to streamline operations across its vast portfolio. Also Read | AI spending vs returns: Why CoreWeave, Meta and Oracle face a debt reality check Cisco : The networking equipment maker slashed over 4,000 jobs—roughly 5% of its global workforce—citing a slowdown in legacy corporate tech spending and a strategic shift toward cybersecurity . Oracle : In one of the year's most significant workforce reductions, Oracle reported a year-over-year headcount decline of approximately 21,000 employees by mid-2026 as it dealt with the enormous cost of expanding its AI cloud infrastructure. Meta, eBay, and Netflix : October brought a fresh wave of cuts across major platforms, signalling that even companies with strong user growth are meticulously trimming their payrolls. AI reallocation The primary driver behind this sustained wave of job cuts in 2026 is a massive reallocation of corporate capital. Tech giants are aggressively cutting legacy operational overhead to fund the immense capital expenditures required to build AI data centres, train foundation models, and hire specialised talent. Also Read | From layoff to ₹1.5 crore UAE offer: How reskilling helped a tech professional India Impact This trend is actively reshaping the Indian tech ecosystem. Indian IT services firms have mirrored the global caution, reporting consecutive quarters of muted headcount growth. Top-tier firms have slowed fresher hiring, focusing instead on internal upskilling, automation, and improving employee utilisation rates to protect margins against macroeconomic headwinds. The current labour market dictates a harsh new reality for 2026: tech companies no longer view sheer headcount as a metric of growth. Instead, revenue per employee and AI readiness have become the defining metrics of corporate health, leaving the global workforce bracing for continuous, targeted reductions.

title: Less than 20 folds, one cracked screen: iPhone Duo buyers raise durability concerns
content: Apple’s first foldable smartphone, the iPhone Duo, is facing early durability concerns after some buyers reported cracked inner displays within hours of receiving their devices. The reports came on October 23, 2026, when the smartphone was launched for sale in markets like China and Australia. The damage reportedly was on the middle fold line near the hinge, casting doubts on how durable the foldable screen is. The cause of the reported damage remains unclear, and it is too early to establish whether the incidents point to a design flaw or a limited batch of defective units. Apple has reportedly already replaced the devices for early customers, and pictures spread around the web show the same kind of damage in other units. iPhone Duo screen reportedly cracks Midnight_Slump, who posted on Reddit and was cited by Android Authority, was one of the detailed accounts and claimed that their iPhone Duo had a cracked inner display effect after about six hours of use. The user said they had only unfolded the device less than 20 times until they saw something in the vicinity of the hinge was broken. In their Reddit post, the buyer said that he felt something under the screen when he opened the phone, and there was a sound of cracking. It is said that the display got separated along the crease in the middle. The user went to an Apple Store later and got his device replaced. Another Reddit user, Bitter_Offer7123, shared images reportedly collected from Chinese online communities. In the images there was damage in a comparable section of the foldable display, which further raised concerns that there may be a recurring issue. Also Read | Forget the ₹3 lakh iPhone Duo! India wants its own smartphone brand by 2028 Similar damage raises questions about foldable design The incidents have led to speculations that the hinge and display crease of the iPhone Duo might be a weak point. However, reports do not clarify either the number of devices involved or if these are the same cause or causes. Early reports from China and Australia surfaced as the device began reaching customers, according to Android Authority. Complaints might have appeared earlier in larger samples of buyers in other markets for this reason. Also Read | iPhone Duo sells out within 5 minutes on Blinkit; How much you could pay monthly Durability tests offer a different picture This is a change from early reviews and durability tests of the iPhone Duo. As per the initial reports, reviewers did not notice the same kind of instant screen failure that occurred. YouTubers Tim Pan and journalist Joanna Stern also made extensive folding tests, finding that signs of wear appeared after repeated use but that there has been no report of the screen breaking during the tests due to crease, according to Android Authority. Apple has reportedly replaced devices belonging to some affected customers, but there is no confirmed public explanation for the failures yet. Other reports here mention that the company will send damaged parts to its engineering teams for inspection.

title: HMD 2660 Flip Senior Edition with AI Companion: What it offers specifically for senior citizens
content: HMD 2660 Flip Senior Edition is a flip phone designed specifically for older adults, combining a simple interface, large buttons and an easy-to-read screen with an artificial intelligence (AI) companion called Mary. Developed in collaboration with inTouch, Mary is designed to engage seniors in conversations, answer questions, share stories and play games. Unlike conventional feature phones that primarily focus on calls and messages, the HMD 2660 Flip Senior Edition also offers an AI-based companionship service that users can access through a dedicated button. The phone aims to make everyday communication easier for older adults while providing an additional way to stay engaged through conversations, without requiring them to download apps or remember passwords. How is HMD 2660 Flip Senior Edition different from regular phones? The phone's main differentiator is its integration of Mary, an AI companion designed around the needs of older adults. While regular feature phones focus on basic communication, this model combines traditional flip-phone functionality with conversational AI. Mary is available around the clock and can discuss topics such as history and nature, share stories, answer questions, play memory games or simply listen. The AI companion can also remember previous interactions to make conversations feel more personal. Another difference is the emphasis on accessibility. The phone features large buttons, a big screen and an easy-to-navigate menu, reducing the complexity often associated with smartphones. Users do not need to download a separate application to access Mary. After activation, they can select the Mary icon from the main menu and press the call button to start a conversation. The device also retains the familiar flip-phone design, allowing users to answer and end calls by opening and closing the handset. What features does HMD 2660 Flip Senior Edition offer for senior citizens? 1. Mary AI companion for conversations and engagement Mary is the phone's standout feature, offering seniors a conversational AI companion they can access whenever they want. It can answer questions, discuss different subjects, share stories and play games. According to HMD, Mary is designed to speak at a slower pace, allow users time to respond and keep conversations simple and meaningful. The service can also remember previous conversations, allowing interactions to build on earlier discussions. 2. Dedicated button for easy access to AI The phone provides a dedicated way to access Mary, reducing the steps required to start a conversation. Users can select the Mary icon in the main menu and press the call button. There is no need to dial a number or navigate through multiple applications. 3. Large screen and big buttons HMD has designed the phone with a large screen and big buttons to make everyday use more accessible. These features are intended to make navigation and phone operation easier for older adults who may prefer a straightforward interface over the multiple menus and applications found on smartphones. 4. Simple interface without app downloads The phone is designed to avoid unnecessary complexity. Mary is built into the device, and users do not need to download an app or remember additional passwords to access the companion after activation. This could make the phone more convenient for seniors who want basic mobile functionality alongside an AI service without having to learn how to use a conventional smartphone. 5. Familiar flip-phone design The traditional flip design allows users to answer and end calls by opening and closing the handset. It also offers a straightforward alternative to touchscreen-only smartphones, with physical buttons and a simpler navigation system. 6. Dust and splash resistance The HMD 2660 Flip Senior Edition carries an IP54 rating, according to the company's product information. This indicates protection against limited dust ingress and water splashes under specified test conditions. However, HMD notes that this resistance is not permanent and can decrease with normal wear. The company advises users to dry the phone carefully if it gets wet and avoid charging it while its connectors are wet or damp. 7. AI subscription and free trial The phone includes an introductory five-hour trial of the inTouch AI companion service. After the trial, users can subscribe for €19.90 per month, with the option to cancel at any time. HMD says the service provider will email the registered address when the trial is nearing its end. There are no automatic charges when the trial expires. Users who do not subscribe can continue using the phone's other features, but Mary will no longer be available. Can Mary replace human companionship for seniors? Mary's ability to respond at a slower pace and remember previous interactions may make it easier for some seniors to use conversational AI. However, an AI companion should not be considered a replacement for family contact, friendships, professional care or medical support. The feature is best understood as an additional way to interact and stay engaged. HMD says conversations with Mary are encrypted and private. Users and families should still review the service's privacy terms to understand how conversation data is processed, stored and retained. What makes the HMD 2660 Flip Senior Edition stand out? The device combines three main elements: a traditional flip phone, accessibility-focused hardware and an AI companion tailored to older adults. Its large buttons, simple menu and dedicated access to Mary distinguish it from basic feature phones, while its limited emphasis on apps may appeal to seniors who do not want a full-fledged smartphone. The key consideration for buyers will be whether the AI companion's conversational features justify the recurring €19.90 monthly subscription after the five-hour trial. title: Oppo ColorOS 17 beta update rolls out early to OnePlus 15, Find X9 series: New features and AI upgrades and more
content: The stable version of ColorOS 17 has started rolling out to the OnePlus 15 and Oppo Find X9 series ahead of the previously announced schedule, according to a report by 91Mobiles. The update was initially scheduled to begin reaching current-generation flagship smartphones from Oppo, OnePlus and Realme on October 29. The early rollout follows the global unveiling of ColorOS 17 by Oppo on 13 October. Based on Android 17, the new software brings changes to the user interface, animation performance, personalisation and artificial intelligence (AI) features. According to 91Mobiles , OnePlus 15 users have begun receiving the stable update, while users on social media have also reported its availability on the Oppo Find X9 series. The latter includes the Find X9, Find X9 Pro, Find X9s and Find X9 Ultra. The report said a OnePlus 15 unit running a pre-release version received an update of around 525MB, carrying build number CPH2745_17.0.0.102(EX01). Users moving from beta software to the stable version may receive smaller update packages, while those upgrading from ColorOS 16 could require a larger download. ColorOS 17: What's new? Oppo says ColorOS 17 introduces a redesigned interface, a new rendering architecture and system-wide AI capabilities. The company describes the update as an effort to make interactions more fluid while improving responsiveness and personalisation. 1. New design and smoother animations ColorOS 17 introduces what Oppo calls the Living Flow Design, with interface elements responding more dynamically to touch. Transitions, buttons, navigation bars and notification panels have been redesigned to create a more fluid visual experience. The changes extend to the lock screen and home screen, where the clock can transition between screens with animated effects. Oppo has also introduced translucent elements and lighting effects across parts of the interface, including the music progress bar. The company says these visual changes are supported by a unified rendering architecture designed to make transitions between interface elements more seamless. 2. Performance improvements with Luminous Rendering Engine The update features Oppo's Luminous Rendering Engine, which is intended to improve animation smoothness and resource management. Oppo says its Adaptive Scheduling Architecture allocates system resources according to the tasks being performed, helping maintain responsiveness during changing workloads. The company also says the system can keep more applications available in the background, allowing users to resume tasks without having to reopen them. Separately, 91Mobiles reported that Oppo claims ColorOS 17 can retain more than 90% of its initial smoothness even when storage is 90% full. 3. AI Mind Space and AI Mind Pilot ColorOS 17 expands the role of AI across the operating system. Oppo's official feature description highlights AI Mind Space, which is designed to organise saved content such as images, notes and places into structured collections. The company also describes AI Mind Suggest as a feature that surfaces relevant information proactively. One example provided by Oppo is tracking flights and displaying useful updates across the system. Separately, 91Mobiles reported that AI Mind Pilot brings services including ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity together in a single application. The report said its agent-based functions can use locally stored files and photos to carry out tasks such as sorting and organising content. These features are intended to help users retrieve information and complete everyday tasks with fewer manual steps. 4. AI-powered photo editing and OSee Oppo is also introducing AI Photo Agent, a tool designed to assist with image editing through prompts. According to the company, users can request changes to elements such as lighting, tone, composition and retouching. They can also use reference images or templates to guide the editing process. Another feature, OSee, is designed to identify what users are looking at and direct them towards a relevant AI service. Oppo says the feature can match the visual input with an appropriate tool. 5. New security and communication features ColorOS 17 adds several AI-assisted features aimed at security and communication. AI Face Swap Detection: Designed to help identify manipulated faces in videos. Synthetic Voice Recognition: Intended to detect AI-generated voices during phone calls and WhatsApp calls. AI Live Interpreter: Translates conversations through compatible earbuds, using speaker recognition to support communication. Enhanced Protection Mode: Offers a simplified interface with larger visual elements and clearer audio, alongside additional protection against scams. The availability of individual features may depend on the device and supported services. ColorOS 17: How to check for the update Users can check whether the stable ColorOS 17 update is available for their device through the phone's software update settings. According to 91Mobiles, users who do not receive an over-the-air notification can also check the release candidate option through the software update menu and beta programme settings. However, availability may vary by device, region and rollout status. Users should check the update information provided for their specific handset before installing it. Which phones are getting ColorOS 17? The initial rollout reports concern the OnePlus 15 and Oppo Find X9 series, although the original schedule also included current-generation flagship smartphones from OnePlus, Oppo and Realme. The early availability reported by 91Mobiles does not establish that the update is available to every eligible handset or in every market. Users should refer to official announcements and their device's update settings for confirmation. While ColorOS 17 brings changes to animations, system performance, AI assistance and security, the early rollout means users may receive the update at different times depending on their device and software version.

title: OnePlus Diwali Sale 2026: Nord 6, OnePlus 15, Nord CE6 Lite get discounts; check offers on phones, earbuds and tablets
content: OnePlus has rolled out festive offers across its smartphone, tablet and audio product ranges in India, combining price reductions, bank discounts and flexible payment options ahead of Diwali. The smartphone offers are available from October 21 to October 25, 2026, while discounts on tablets and audio products run until October 27, according to the information available on the company website. Customers can access the deals through the OnePlus India website, the OnePlus Store app and Amazon India during its Great Indian Festival sale. Eligible buyers can also use payment options such as no-cost EMI, Amazon BFL and paper-based financing, subject to applicable terms. OnePlus is offering free accessories with select tablet purchases.
